## SeederRunner class

Loads a seeder class by name and runs it against the given connection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class SeederRunner 
```

## Remarks

A seeder is found by filename, so `"UserSeeder"` loads `UserSeeder.ts` (or `.mts` / `.js` / `.mjs`<!-- -->) from the configured directory. Files are imported dynamically, so a `.ts` seeder needs a loader such as `tsx` in the running process.

Nothing is tracked between runs — seeding twice inserts twice.

## Example


```ts
const seeders = new SeederRunner(connection, { path: './src/database/seeders' })
await seeders.run()             // DatabaseSeeder
await seeders.run('UserSeeder') // just this one
```
